purpose: Teach: サンバ/ボビー/パトリック/クリストファー/リンダ/アーク/アナン/サドル

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがサンバ・カーニバルを観られた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he saw the Samba Carnival.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Slow, deliberate pacing. Each phrase lands with quiet weight, as if turning over something precious and half-forgotten.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ボビー・ヴィントンのレコードがお好きだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and your father loved listening to Bobby Vinton records, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, gently correcting—not unkindly. A knowing smile in the voice. Tender affection layered with the ease of long memory shared. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがパトリック先生の英語教室に通われた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he attended Patrick's English classes.
lines.style: Same distant reverie as before. Measured breath between thoughts. The voice holds each detail like a photograph—present but unreachable.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、クリストファー・コロンブスの伝記を孫に読まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father read Christopher Columbus's biography to his grandchildren, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle, testing—checking if he remembers too. Tender but with a note of quiet correction. Warm ending, drawing him back.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがリンダ・ロンシュタットのアルバムを集められた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he collected Linda Ronstadt albums.
lines.style: The same wistful register, but slightly more present—these details matter to him. Quiet but steady. A small breath before the final phrase.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、アーク橋の写真集をお持ちだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father had quite a photo collection of arch bridges, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Amused undertone—this detail is unexpected, oddly specific. Tender but with gentle humor. The closing 'dear' wraps him back in the present moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがアナン事務総長の演説を聴かれた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he heard Secretary-General Annan speak.
lines.style: The wistfulness deepens here, almost fragile. Very slow. Each word placed with care. The trailing-off suggests something beyond words—a moment he's reaching for.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、自転車のサドルをご自分で交換されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father replaced his bicycle saddle himself, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Tender, with a knowing softness. Quieter than before, almost a whisper. The closing phrase draws close—intimate, checking in. Slight fadeout on 'dear'.
